Browser-local today (localStorage 'fw-maker', lib/maker.ts:28-32). Wish has no place for these; server must either add fields (wedding day, opens-now flag, voice seconds) or keep them as draft metadata. 'now' is derived into opensAt at seal.

actions.name: shareLink
actions.note: Share (navigator.share) and Copy (clipboard) are browser-only; no server call. Link built as `${origin}/w/mine?id=${wish.id}` (Seal.tsx Sealed) - a wish's public link slug is server-issued per conventions.

authContext.note: Maker.tsx:181 renders a blank busy shell if no account; no redirect inside the maker.
